owner ruling: file an issue with a priority (not roadmap) and keep PR-4a observability-only; the batch loss is unchanged by this PR
adjudicated_by: Dave Rae (repository owner), ruling given in an AskUserQuestion window of the authoring session on 2026-11-13; separation applied: de-escalation rule (a gating row deferred to an issue). Caveat: the commit author identity is also Dave Rae, so a git-author self-name check will read this as self-named; the ruling is the owner's and the commits carry Claude as co-author
adjudication_rationale: pre-existing batch loss in untouched code, not introduced or made newly reachable by PR-4a (observability only); fixing it would widen PR-4a with new label values, docs, alert text and a further governance round; the owner chose a priority-bearing follow-up issue
